mentions.name: goblin
mentions.description: A scripting language that compiles to Go, featuring dynamic, minimal syntax for scripting. Programs compile to a single static binary with no runtime to ship, making deployment easy anywhere, and can use Go's concurrency primitives (goroutines/channels). Intentionally feature-light so someone with programming experience can pick it up in half an hour; still very early stage.
mentions.audience: People with programming experience looking for a small, easy-to-learn scripting language
